_comment: 登入頁（web/static/login.html）的介面字串：{{t:鍵}} 換成 HTML 跳脫的字、{{tjs:鍵}} 換成 JS 字串字面值。伺服器依 tf_locale cookie（SPA 寫的語言偏好）→ profile 預設挑語系（web/routers/auth_pages.py）。兩個語系的鍵必須相同（tests/test_login_i18n.py）。譯名照 frontend/src/i18n/GLOSSARY.md。

totp_sub.zh-Hant: 請輸入驗證器 App 顯示的 6 位數驗證碼。
totp_sub.en: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the authenticator app.

footer.zh-Hant: 研究部內部系統 · 請以配發帳號登入
footer.en: Internal research system. Sign in with the issued account.

eyebrow.zh-Hant: 券商研究報告 · 智能檢索平台

slogan_1.en: From a sea of research reports,

tile_qa_desc.zh-Hant: 以自然語言提問，AI 檢索研報後整理回答，每段附引用來源。
tile_qa_desc.en: Ask in natural language; AI searches the reports and compiles an answer with a cited source for every paragraph.

demo_question.zh-Hant: 台積電先進製程的最新展望如何？
demo_question.en: What is the latest outlook for TSMC’s advanced process nodes?

grounded.zh-Hant: 依據 4 篇研報，每段附出處
grounded.en: Based on 4 reports, every paragraph sourced

tile_search_desc.zh-Hant: 語意＋關鍵字混合檢索，用字不必與原文相同；可依市場、商品類型與報告類型篩選。
tile_search_desc.en: Hybrid semantic and keyword search, so wording needn’t match the source; filter by market, asset class and report type.

tile_reading_desc.zh-Hant: 內嵌原始 PDF，並列重點摘錄、券商訊號與相似研報。
tile_reading_desc.en: The original PDF embedded alongside key takeaways, broker signals and similar reports.

tile_radar_desc.zh-Hant: 彙整同一標的各家券商的評等、目標價與 EPS，追蹤觀點變化。
tile_radar_desc.en: Compiles every broker’s rating, target price and EPS for an instrument and tracks how views change.

tile_brief_desc.zh-Hant: 每日彙整各家券商研報的重點，整理成一份簡報。
tile_brief_desc.en: Compiles the key points of each broker’s reports into one brief every day.

err_totp.zh-Hant: 驗證碼不正確或已使用過，請輸入驗證器目前顯示的碼。
err_totp.en: The code is wrong or has already been used. Enter the code the authenticator shows now.

err_expired.zh-Hant: 驗證步驟已逾時，請重新輸入帳號密碼。
err_expired.en: The verification step timed out. Enter the username and password again.

err_locked.zh-Hant: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試。
err_locked.en: Too many attempts. Try again later.

err_insecure.zh-Hant: 此登入只接受 HTTPS 或本機 localhost，請改走受保護入口。
err_insecure.en: This sign-in only accepts HTTPS or local localhost. Use the protected entry point.

err_disabled.zh-Hant: 此帳號已停用，請聯絡管理者。
err_disabled.en: This account is disabled. Contact an administrator.

err_unavailable.zh-Hant: 登入服務暫時無法使用，請稍後再試。
err_unavailable.en: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

err_sso.zh-Hant: 公司帳號登入沒有完成，請重新登入。
err_sso.en: The company account sign-in didn’t complete. Sign in again.

err_sso_unavailable.zh-Hant: 公司帳號登入服務暫時無法使用，請稍後再試。
err_sso_unavailable.en: The company account sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

err_sso_account.zh-Hant: 這個公司帳號無法登入本系統，請聯絡管理者。
err_sso_account.en: This company account can’t sign in to this system. Contact an administrator.

err_sso_only.en: Sign in with the company account instead.

hint_off.zh-Hant: 請以管理者配發的帳號登入。
hint_off.en: Sign in with the account issued by an administrator.

hint_on.zh-Hant: 請以公司帳號或管理者配發的帳號登入。
hint_on.en: Sign in with a company account or the account issued by an administrator.

hint_only.en: Sign in with a company account.
